(() => {
    const board = document.querySelector(".board");
    if (!board)
        return;
    const input = document.querySelector(".board-tools input");
    const lanes = Array.from(board.querySelectorAll(".lane"));
    function applyFilter() {
        var _a;
        const query = ((_a = input === null || input === void 0 ? void 0 : input.value) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : "").trim().toLowerCase();
        lanes.forEach((lane) => {
            let shown = 0;
            lane.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach((card) => {
                var _a;
                const match = !query || ((_a = card.textContent) !== null && _a !== void 0 ? _a : "").toLowerCase().includes(query);
                card.hidden = !match;
                if (match)
                    shown++;
            });
            const count = lane.querySelector("h2 span");
            if (count)
                count.textContent = String(shown);
        });
    }
    input === null || input === void 0 ? void 0 : input.addEventListener("input", applyFilter);
    lanes.forEach((lane) => {
        const head = lane.querySelector("h2");
        if (!head)
            return;
        head.tabIndex = 0;
        head.setAttribute("role", "button");
        head.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        function toggle() {
            const collapsed = lane.classList.toggle("collapsed");
            head.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!collapsed));
        }
        head.addEventListener("click", toggle);
        head.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
            if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
                event.preventDefault();
                toggle();
            }
        });
    });
})();
